يستنصروا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْصِرُوا (yastanṣirū) /jas.tan.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# يُسْتَنْصَرُوا (yustanṣarū) /jus.tan.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
